description: sfxnz's two-Spark GLM-5.3-Flash recipe (kit 01ffd10b, v4 / V6-m4): patched TensorFold (ashhart/TensorFold 81de26f6 plus the kit's 39 engine patches, built from source) on the stock 1.2.10 runtime, at TP=2 over the direct RoCE link, serving sfxnz's EXL3 4bpw pack (routed experts EXL3 4 bpw, the rest Z.AI's BF16) with vision, thinking and DFlash2 drafting on. Up to 4 requests at once and one request up to 524,288 tokens, over sharded FP8 KV pages (each Spark holds half of every latent row) with up to 16 kept prompt states (TF_KV_SHARE 16); DFlash2 drafting is split across both Sparks (4-bit drafter, TF_GLM_DRAFT_ONLY_HEAD), dense linears and the head are packed to 8 bits at load, and decode runs in CUDA graphs. The DFlash2 drafter is Inco AI's (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, non-commercial): licence information only, nothing here enforces it. The creator publishes no image: the image installs the checksummed 1.2.10 release archive on NVIDIA's CUDA 13.0 base, replaces its tensorfold-native with the patched build, and Controller placement supplies rank, rendezvous and RoCE rails instead of run.sh's ssh and docker. Memory is an estimate until a hardware try (110 GB peak per Spark, 11.3 GB host reserve); the creator's figures (throughput, long-context needle results, NLL gate) are upstream claims, not measured here.
title: GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 4bpw TensorFold dual Spark (sfxnz)
